name: Ramina Llobregós
source:
The girl who represents order and virtue of the school: the president of the Student Committee. A friend of many years, reliable, positive, sweet, smart and athletic. Her deepest meaning of justice is equal to her special reserved stomach only for sweets.

"I'll believe in you because I know you won't disappoint me!"

[Edited from the [url=https://img.itch.zone/aW1nLzg3MzA3MDQucG5n/original/A0Wn9N.png]character profile[/url]]
